### Welcome to my personal website!

I'm a researcher, engineer, software developer, wife, volunteer, and an Associate Professor at the [Department of Management and Engineering](http://www.gest.unipd.it) of the [University of Padua](http://www.unipd.it), Italy. 
 
I'll always procrastinate updating my web site. Please see my [about](cv.qmd) page for more biographical information and my [publications](publications.qmd) page for more research information. 

::: {#hero-heading}
